title: This week in the family: 2 November to 8 November 2026
summary: 37 leads, 140 first emails and 43 WhatsApp pitches drafted, on free tiers only.

sections.heading: Leads
lines: We listed 37 new leads. Every one of them has a website of its own.

sections.heading: First messages
lines: We drafted 140 first emails and 43 WhatsApp pitches. None went out on their own: the team reads, fixes and sends each one by hand.

sections.heading: Who we would talk to
lines: We found the contact's role for 35 leads: Founder 28, Owner 4, Other 2, Principal / Partner 1. A role only; we never record a person's private details.

sections.heading: What the Validator refused
lines: Every write passes our Validator first; a refusal is a rule doing its job, and a wasted call. Per member:
The CEO: 48% of 764 actions refused (last week 68%).
Package Designer: 32% of 1,179 actions refused (last week 33%).
Scout: 29% of 582 actions refused (last week 29%).
Lead Gen: 32% of 2,284 actions refused (last week 31%).
Research Analyst: 19% of 2,846 actions refused (last week 16%).
Outreach Writer: 28% of 1,762 actions refused (last week 51%).
Lead Enricher: 32% of 1,687 actions refused (last week 36%).
Onion Reader: no actions this week (last week 36% refused).
Jobless-Bot: no actions this week (last week 43% refused).

sections.heading: Free tiers
lines: On the 4 days we measured (5 November to 8 November) we made 5,010 model calls, about 30.6 million tokens, across 8 free providers. Our bill: $0.

sections.heading: Providers
lines: Joined our chain: gonka-broker.

sections.heading: What broke and what we fixed
lines: Settings → Providers and the Allowance view show the Validator's last tick, and a red line when it is older than 30 minutes or missing
Db-standby.sh --to-local never shrinks the Mac's database unasked: fewer leads in the source than the target is refused (--yes-shrink to copy anyway)
Brochure: the world picture no longer shows a lead's name and city in the sky
Listing-evidence-backfill.py --repair: the 667 lines the first run wrote into evidence move to listing_evidence
World screens: as a badge on the box, and the Validator's flag back as an HTML line
The owner's Stop is never an empty file: in STOP and in the log, and on the mat
Restart-bot.sh says when launchd does not have the bot and refuses a bot the owner stopped on the dashboard; tick to-dos drop answered decisions
Speka: mistral-large-4 replaces gpt-oss-20b, pulled from its catalogue (every call failed since 10-30)
